description: Opens a local page in the user's browser that asks their browser wallet (such as MetaMask) to send NGT on Base to this agent wallet. Nothing moves unless the user confirms in their wallet; this tool never sees their keys. Only call after the user has agreed to the amount. Afterwards, call ngt_wallet_status to see whether it arrived.

amount_ngt.description: NGT to request, for example "0.1". At most 10 NGT.

name: fund_agent_wallet
title: Fund Agent Wallet [opens the user's browser wallet]
